# Disposable application tests, independent of the shared dev server.
# Dispatches come from scripts/ci_coordinator.py and bind an exact source SHA.
# The same runner contract serves candidate and nightly test batches.
name: Isolated application tests
run-name: "Isolated tests ${{ inputs.mode }} ${{ inputs.dispatch_token }}"
on:
  push:
    branches: [dev]
    paths: ['.github/workflows/isolated-tests.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      checkout_ref:
        required: true
        type: string
      source_commit:
        required: true
        type: string
      candidate_tree:
        type: string
        default: ''
      candidate_owner:
        type: string
        default: ''
      candidate_patch_sha256:
        type: string
        default: ''
      candidate_patch_url:
        type: string
        default: ''
      specs_json:
        required: true
        type: string
        default: '[]'
      case_title:
        type: string
        default: ''
      mode:
        type: choice
        options: [prepare, backend-probe, component, e2e, artifact, codex, pytest, vitest, selfhost, visual-smoke, sdk-conformance, sdk-lockfiles, rust-wasm, rust-native-dev]
        default: e2e
      preparation_key:
        description: Exact immutable preparation identity supplied by the coordinator
        type: string
        default: ''
      harness_commit:
        description: Exact CI harness shared by a preparation producer and its consumers
        type: string
        default: ''
      prepared_run_id:
        description: Exact successful producer run; consumers never search by artifact name
        type: string
        default: ''
      runtime_seed:
        description: Coordinator-issued runtime images; backend-probe or unprepared E2E only
        type: string
        default: ''
      preparation_transport:
        description: Private presigned preparation transfer ticket
        type: string
        default: ''
      prepare_cli:
        description: Whether this preparation/consumer requires CLI output
        type: string
        default: 'true'
      prepare_upload:
        description: Whether this preparation/consumer requires the upload runtime
        type: string
        default: 'false'
      native_dev_transport:
        description: Private closed native compilation output ticket from coordinator
        type: string
        default: ''
      dispatch_token:
        required: true
        type: string
      proof_video_profile:
        type: string
        default: ''
      capacity_configuration:
        description: Source-bound calibration and rate settings supplied by the coordinator
        type: string
        default: ''
permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  packages: read
jobs:
  test:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ${{ contains(inputs.specs_json, 'storage-capacity-target.spec.ts') && fromJSON('["self-hosted","Linux","X64","openmates-capacity"]') || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev' && fromJSON('["ubuntu-24.04-arm"]') || fromJSON('["ubuntu-latest"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ contains(inputs.specs_json, 'storage-capacity-target.spec.ts') && 2880 || inputs.mode == 'selfhost' && 120 || inputs.mode == 'backend-probe' && 12 || 60 }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: subject
    env:
      CI_TEST_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      CI: 'true'
      OPENMATES_CI_ISOLATED: '1'
      OPENMATES_CI_SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/subject
      CI_HARNESS_COMMIT: ${{ inputs.harness_commit || github.sha }}
      CI_PREPARATION_KEY: ${{ inputs.preparation_key }}
      CI_PREPARED_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_run_id }}
      CI_RUNTIME_SEED: ${{ inputs.runtime_seed }}
      CI_CAPACITY_CONFIGURATION: ${{ inputs.capacity_configuration }}
      CI_SPECS_JSON: ${{ inputs.specs_json }}
      CI_CASE_TITLE: ${{ inputs.case_title }}
      PLAYWRIGHT_PROOF_VIDEO_PROFILE: ${{ inputs.proof_video_profile }}
      PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER_NAME: ${{ contains(inputs.specs_json, 'example-chat-ipad-multitab.spec.ts') && 'webkit' || 'chromium' }}
      PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:5173
      OPENMATES_E2E_API_URL: http://localhost:8000
      OPENMATES_API_URL: http://localhost:8000
      VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:8000
      VITE_UPLOAD_URL: http://localhost:5173
      VITE_ENV: self_hosted
      E2E_USE_MOCKS: '1'
      E2E_USE_LIVE_MOCKS: '1'
      DOCKER_BUILD_RECORD_UPLOAD: 'false'
      NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
    steps:
      - name: Start bounded private native compilation clock
        if: inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev'
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYNATIVE'
          import os, time
          started = time.monotonic()
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as output:
              output.write(f'CI_NATIVE_DEV_STARTED_MONOTONIC={started}\n')
              output.write(f'CI_NATIVE_DEV_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC={started + 2700}\n')
          PYNATIVE
      - name: Start bounded self-host clock
        if: inputs.mode == 'selfhost'
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYSELFHOST'
          import os, time
          started = time.monotonic()
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as output:
              output.write(f'CI_SELFHOST_STARTED_MONOTONIC={started}\n')
              output.write(f'CI_SELFHOST_WORK_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC={started + 6300}\n')
              output.write(f'CI_SELFHOST_CLEANUP_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC={started + 7020}\n')
          PYSELFHOST
      - name: Start bounded same-source browser package clock
        if: inputs.mode == 'e2e' && (inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-browser-session.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-browser-password-entry.spec.ts"]' || (inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-saved-session.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-platform.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-saved-session.spec.ts","rust-core-production-platform.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-platform.spec.ts","rust-core-production-saved-session.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-local-cursor.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-saved-session.spec.ts","rust-core-production-local-cursor.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-platform.spec.ts","rust-core-production-local-cursor.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-local-cursor.spec.ts","rust-core-production-saved-session.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-local-cursor.spec.ts","rust-core-production-platform.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-saved-paging.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-saved-session.spec.ts","rust-core-production-saved-paging.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-platform.spec.ts","rust-core-production-saved-paging.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-local-cursor.spec.ts","rust-core-production-saved-paging.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-saved-paging.spec.ts","rust-core-production-saved-session.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-saved-paging.spec.ts","rust-core-production-platform.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-saved-paging.spec.ts","rust-core-production-local-cursor.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-ordinary-login-retention.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-saved-session.spec.ts","rust-core-ordinary-login-retention.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-platform.spec.ts","rust-core-ordinary-login-retention.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-local-cursor.spec.ts","rust-core-ordinary-login-retention.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-production-saved-paging.spec.ts","rust-core-ordinary-login-retention.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-ordinary-login-retention.spec.ts","rust-core-production-saved-session.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-ordinary-login-retention.spec.ts","rust-core-production-platform.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-ordinary-login-retention.spec.ts","rust-core-production-local-cursor.spec.ts"]' || inputs.specs_json == '["rust-core-ordinary-login-retention.spec.ts","rust-core-production-saved-paging.spec.ts"]'))
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYBROWSER'
          import os, time
          started = time.monotonic()
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as output:
              output.write(f'CI_BROWSER_PACKAGE_STARTED_MONOTONIC={started}\n')
              output.write(f'CI_BROWSER_PACKAGE_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC={started + 1800}\n')
          PYBROWSER
      - name: Start bounded Rust WASM compilation clock
        if: inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm'
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYWASM'
          import os, time
          started = time.monotonic()
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as output:
              output.write(f'CI_RUST_WASM_STARTED_MONOTONIC={started}\n')
              output.write(f'CI_RUST_WASM_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC={started + 2700}\n')
          PYWASM
      - name: Start bounded SDK lock preparation clock
        if: inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles'
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYLOCK'
          import os, time
          started = time.monotonic()
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as output:
              output.write(f'CI_SDK_LOCKFILES_STARTED_MONOTONIC={started}\n')
              output.write(f'CI_SDK_LOCKFILES_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC={started + 1200}\n')
          PYLOCK
      - name: Start bounded SDK conformance clock
        if: inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance'
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYSDK'
          import os, time
          started = time.monotonic()
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as output:
              output.write(f'CI_SDK_STARTED_MONOTONIC={started}\n')
              output.write(f'CI_SDK_DEADLINE_MONOTONIC={started + 2700}\n')
          PYSDK
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance' || inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles' || inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm' || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev') && 5 || 360 }}
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.checkout_ref }}
          path: subject
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance' || inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles' || inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm' || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev') && 5 || 360 }}
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.harness_commit || github.sha }}
          path: tooling
          sparse-checkout: scripts
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require private preparation transport ticket
        if: >-
          inputs.mode == 'prepare' ||
          ((inputs.mode == 'e2e' || inputs.mode == 'visual-smoke') &&
           inputs.preparation_key != '')
        run: python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_preparation_transport.py validate
      - name: Create private Node supplier toolcache
        if: inputs.mode != 'pytest' && inputs.mode != 'backend-probe' && inputs.mode != 'sdk-lockfiles' && inputs.mode != 'rust-native-dev'
        run: |
          # Hosted images chmod /opt recursively to 0777, including cached Node.
          # Use a fresh private supplier; keep the producer's world-write
          # refusal and the image's cache untouched.
          supplier_cache=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/openmates-node-supplier.XXXXXXXX")
          echo "OPENMATES_CI_NODE_SUPPLIER_CACHE=$supplier_cache" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Download verified official Node supplier
        timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance' || inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles' || inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm' || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev') && 3 || 360 }}
        if: inputs.mode != 'pytest' && inputs.mode != 'backend-probe' && inputs.mode != 'sdk-lockfiles' && inputs.mode != 'rust-native-dev'
        run: python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_download_node_supplier.py
      - name: Stage attested runner Node before candidate code or dependencies
        timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance' || inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles' || inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm' || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev') && 3 || 360 }}
        if: inputs.mode != 'pytest' && inputs.mode != 'backend-probe' && inputs.mode != 'sdk-lockfiles' && inputs.mode != 'rust-native-dev'
        env:
          OPENMATES_CI_EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source_commit }}
        # RUNNER_* step env is overwritten by runner context injection. Set the
        # attested cache inside the shell, after injection, for this process only.
        run: >-
          env -u NODE_OPTIONS -u NODE_PATH
          RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE="$OPENMATES_CI_NODE_SUPPLIER_CACHE"
          "$OPENMATES_CI_NODE_SUPPLIER" ../tooling/scripts/ci_stage_node_runtime.mjs stage
      - name: Reconstruct and verify exact detached source
        timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance' || inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles' || inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm' || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev') && 5 || 360 }}
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source_commit }}
          EXPECTED_TREE: ${{ inputs.candidate_tree }}
          CANDIDATE_OWNER: ${{ inputs.candidate_owner }}
          CANDIDATE_PATCH_SHA256: ${{ inputs.candidate_patch_sha256 }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, urllib.parse, urllib.request

          expected = os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE']
          assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', expected), 'Full source SHA required'
          event = json.load(open(os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_PATH']))
          patch_url = event.get('inputs', {}).get('candidate_patch_url', '')
          if patch_url:
              print(f'::add-mask::{patch_url}')
          values = [
              os.environ['EXPECTED_TREE'], os.environ['CANDIDATE_OWNER'],
              os.environ['CANDIDATE_PATCH_SHA256'], patch_url,
          ]
          if any(values):
              assert all(values), 'Candidate artifact identity must be complete'
              tree, owner, digest, url = values
              assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', tree), 'Full candidate tree SHA required'
              assert re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}', owner), 'Valid candidate owner required'
              assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', digest), 'Valid patch SHA-256 required'
              parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
              assert parsed.scheme == 'https' and parsed.hostname
              assert parsed.hostname.endswith('.your-objectstorage.com')
              assert not parsed.username and not parsed.password and parsed.query and not parsed.fragment
              patch = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=120).read(100 * 1024**2 + 1)
              assert len(patch) <= 100 * 1024**2, 'Candidate patch exceeds 100 MiB'
              assert hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest() == digest, 'Candidate patch digest mismatch'
              open('../candidate.patch', 'wb').write(patch)
              subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', '--binary', '--index', '--check', '../candidate.patch'], check=True)
              subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', '--binary', '--index', '../candidate.patch'], check=True)
              actual_tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'write-tree'], text=True).strip()
              assert actual_tree == tree, 'Candidate tree mismatch'
              parent = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
              timestamp = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '-s', '--format=%cI', parent], text=True).strip()
              commit_env = {
                  **os.environ,
                  'GIT_AUTHOR_NAME': 'OpenMates CI', 'GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL': 'ci@example.com',
                  'GIT_COMMITTER_NAME': 'OpenMates CI', 'GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL': 'ci@example.com',
                  'GIT_AUTHOR_DATE': timestamp, 'GIT_COMMITTER_DATE': timestamp,
              }
              rebuilt = subprocess.check_output(
                  ['git', 'commit-tree', tree, '-p', parent],
                  input=f'CI candidate for session {owner}\n', text=True, env=commit_env,
              ).strip()
              assert rebuilt == expected, 'Candidate commit identity mismatch'
              subprocess.run(['git', 'reset', '--hard', expected], check=True)
          else:
              actual = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
              assert actual == expected, 'Checked-out source mismatch'
          assert subprocess.run(['git', 'symbolic-ref', '-q', 'HEAD']).returncode == 1, 'Source must remain detached'
          actual_tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'], text=True).strip()
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as handle:
              handle.write(f'CI_CANDIDATE_TREE={actual_tree}\n')
          PY
          echo "BUILD_COMMIT_SHA=$EXPECTED_SOURCE" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo '127.0.0.2 api.dev.openmates.org app.dev.openmates.org' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts
          echo '127.0.0.1 storage.ci.test' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance' || inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles' || inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm' || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev') && 3 || 360 }}
        if: inputs.mode != 'pytest' && inputs.mode != 'backend-probe' && inputs.mode != 'sdk-lockfiles' && inputs.mode != 'rust-native-dev' && inputs.mode != 'rust-wasm'
        with:
          package_json_file: subject/package.json
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance' || inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles' || inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm' || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev') && 3 || 360 }}
        if: inputs.mode != 'pytest' && inputs.mode != 'backend-probe' && inputs.mode != 'sdk-lockfiles' && inputs.mode != 'rust-native-dev' && inputs.mode != 'rust-wasm'
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: subject/pnpm-lock.yaml
      - name: Restore pinned Node after package-manager cache setup
        timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance' || inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles' || inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm' || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev') && 1 || 360 }}
        if: inputs.mode != 'pytest' && inputs.mode != 'backend-probe' && inputs.mode != 'sdk-lockfiles' && inputs.mode != 'rust-native-dev'
        run: |
          env -u NODE_OPTIONS -u NODE_PATH "$OPENMATES_CI_NODE" ../tooling/scripts/ci_stage_node_runtime.mjs verify
          dirname "$OPENMATES_CI_NODE" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        timeout-minutes: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance' || inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles' || inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm' || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev') && 3 || 360 }}
        with:
          python-version: ${{ (inputs.mode == 'sdk-conformance' || inputs.mode == 'sdk-lockfiles' || inputs.mode == 'rust-wasm' || inputs.mode == 'rust-native-dev') && '3.12' || '3.13' }}
          cache: ${{ inputs.mode == 'pytest' && 'pip' || '' }}
          cache-dependency-path: |
            subject/backend/requirements-dev.txt
            subject/backend/core/api/requirements.txt
            subject/packages/openmates-python/pyproject.toml
      - name: Install workspace dependencies
        if: inputs.mode != 'pytest' && inputs.mode != 'backend-probe' && inputs.mode != 'sdk-lockfiles' && inputs.mode != 'rust-native-dev' && inputs.mode != 'rust-wasm' && inputs.mode != 'sdk-conformance'
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Stage exact capacity calibration and rate settings
        if: inputs.capacity_configuration != '' || contains(inputs.specs_json, 'storage-capacity-target.spec.ts')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_capacity_config.py
      - name: Prepare isolated stack
        id: profile
        if: inputs.mode == 'prepare' || inputs.mode == 'e2e' || inputs.mode == 'visual-smoke' || inputs.mode == 'backend-probe'
        run: |
          python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_environment.py prepare
      - name: Verify declared upload capability
        if: >-
          (inputs.mode == 'e2e' || inputs.mode == 'visual-smoke') &&
          inputs.preparation_key != ''
        run: test "${{ steps.profile.outputs.uploads }}" = "${{ inputs.prepare_upload }}"
      - name: Log in to GHCR for compatible runtime images
        if: inputs.mode == 'prepare' || inputs.mode == 'e2e' || inputs.mode == 'visual-smoke' || inputs.mode == 'backend-probe'
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Download exact private prepared build
        id: preparation-download
        if: >-
          (inputs.mode == 'e2e' || inputs.mode == 'visual-smoke') &&
          inputs.prepared_run_id != '' && inputs.preparation_key != ''
        continue-on-error: true
        run: >-
          python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_preparation_transport.py download
          --directory test-results/ci-preparation-download
      - name: Verify and restore prepared web and CLI bytes
        id: artifacts
        if: inputs.mode == 'e2e' || inputs.mode == 'visual-smoke'
        run: |
          python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_artifacts.py restore \
            --source "$BUILD_COMMIT_SHA" \
            --candidate-tree "$CI_CANDIDATE_TREE" \
            --include-cli "${{ inputs.prepare_cli }}" \
            --include-upload "${{ inputs.prepare_upload }}" \
            --expected-key "${{ inputs.preparation_key }}" \
            --harness-commit "$CI_HARNESS_COMMIT" \
            --input-dir test-results/ci-preparation-download
      - name: Download exact private backend runtime seed
        if: >-
          inputs.runtime_seed != '' &&
          (inputs.mode == 'backend-probe' ||
           (inputs.mode == 'e2e' && inputs.preparation_key == '' && inputs.prepared_run_id == ''))
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: >-
          python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_preparation_transport.py download-runtime
          --directory test-results/ci-runtime-seed
      - name: Reuse compatible published runtime images
        id: images
        if: inputs.mode == 'prepare' || inputs.mode == 'e2e' || inputs.mode == 'visual-smoke' || inputs.mode == 'backend-probe'
        timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.mode == 'backend-probe' && 3 || 30 }}
        run: |
          upload_args=()
          needs_upload="${{ inputs.prepare_upload }}"
          if [ -z "${{ inputs.preparation_key }}" ]; then
            needs_upload="${{ steps.profile.outputs.uploads }}"
          fi
          if [ "$needs_upload" = 'true' ]; then
            upload_args+=(--include-upload)
          fi
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.runtime_seed != '' && 'seeded' || '' }}" ]; then
            python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_runtime_images.py restore \
              --manifest test-results/ci-runtime-seed/manifest.json
          elif [ "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.prepared }}" = 'true' ]; then
            if ! python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_runtime_images.py restore \
              "${upload_args[@]}" \
              --manifest "${{ steps.artifacts.outputs.manifest }}"; then
              python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_artifacts.py runtime-fallback \
                --reason runtime_manifest_rejected
              python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_runtime_images.py restore "${upload_args[@]}"
            fi
          else
            python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_runtime_images.py restore "${upload_args[@]}"
          fi
      - name: Require published backend images and prepared schema
        if: inputs.mode == 'backend-probe'
        timeout-minutes: 1
        run: python3 ../tooling/scripts/isolated_worker_broker_probe.py preflight
      - name: Calculate runtime compatibility keys
        id: runtime_keys
        if: inputs.mode == 'prepare' || inputs.mode == 'e2e' || inputs.mode == 'visual-smoke'
        run: |
          for kind in api cms setup schema upload; do
            echo "$kind=$(python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_runtime_images.py key --kind "$kind")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          done
          python3 ../tooling/scripts/ci_runtime_images.py schema-contract >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
        if: >-
          (inputs.mode == 'prepare' || inputs.mode == 'e2e' || inputs.mode == 'visual-smoke') &&
          (steps.images.outputs.api != 'true' ||
           steps.images.outputs.cms != 'true' ||
           steps.images.outputs.setup != 'true' ||
           (inputs.mode == 'prepare' && steps.images.outputs.schema != 'true') ||
           (((inputs.preparation_key != '' && inputs.prepare_upload == 'true') ||
             (inputs.preparation_key == '' && steps.profile.outputs.uploads == 'true')) &&

def record_capacity_startup(diagnostic_path, facts):
    if diagnostic_path is None:

    path = Path(diagnostic_path)
    previous = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {"schema": "agentic-storage-capacity-startup-v1", "checks": []}
    previous["checks"].append(facts)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(previous, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    path.chmod(0o600)


def run_capacity_startup_guard(stage, runner, *, expected_status, source_commit, diagnostic_path=None):
    """Require a typed success; expose only bounded, allowlisted failure facts."""
    if stage not in {"inventory_refresh", "fixture_setup"}:
        raise ValueError("Unknown capacity startup guard")
    try:
        result = runner()
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as error:
        result = error
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        record_capacity_startup(diagnostic_path, {"stage": stage, "admitted": False, "error_class": "TimeoutExpired"})
        raise RuntimeError(f"Isolated capacity startup is unverified (stage={stage}; timeout)") from None
    raw = result.stdout or ""
    details = None
    if isinstance(raw, str) and len(raw) <= 65536:
        try:
            details = json.loads(raw)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
    valid = (isinstance(details, dict) and result.returncode == 0
             and details.get("status") == expected_status
             and details.get("source_commit") == source_commit)
    if stage == "inventory_refresh":
        valid = (valid and type(details.get("api_processes")) is int
                 and 1 <= details["api_processes"] <= 128
                 and details.get("expires_in_seconds") == 180)
    elif valid:
        valid = type(details.get("collections_count")) is int and 1 <= details["collections_count"] <= 128
    facts = {"stage": stage, "admitted": bool(valid), "exit_code": result.returncode, "expected_source": source_commit}
    summary = f"stage={stage}; exit={result.returncode}"
    if isinstance(details, dict):
        status = details.get("status")
        if isinstance(status, str) and status in {"published", "ready", "paused", "failed"}:
            summary += f"; status={status}"
            facts["status"] = status
        reason = details.get("reason")
        if isinstance(reason, str) and reason in CAPACITY_STARTUP_REASONS:
            summary += f"; reason={reason}"
            facts["reason"] = reason
        failure_stage = details.get("stage")
        if isinstance(failure_stage, str) and failure_stage in {"compose", "inspect", "cohort", "publish", "bootstrap", "rollout"}:
            summary += f"; failed_stage={failure_stage}"
            facts["failed_stage"] = failure_stage
        error_class = details.get("error_class")
        if isinstance(error_class, str) and error_class in {"ValueError", "TypeError", "KeyError", "AttributeError", "ImportError", "ModuleNotFoundError",
                           "RuntimeError", "CalledProcessError", "TimeoutExpired", "JSONDecodeError", "ConnectionError"}:
            summary += f"; class={error_class}"
            facts["error_class"] = error_class
        for field in ("container_count", "api_processes", "exit_code", "collections_count", "expires_in_seconds"):
            value = details.get(field)
            if type(value) is int and 0 <= value <= (180 if field == "expires_in_seconds" else 128):
                summary += f"; {field}={value}"
                facts["remote_" + field if field == "exit_code" else field] = value
        source = details.get("source_commit")
        if isinstance(source, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{40}", source):
            summary += f"; source={source}"
            facts["source_commit"] = source
    record_capacity_startup(diagnostic_path, facts)
    if valid:
        return details
    raise RuntimeError("Isolated capacity startup is unverified (" + summary + ")") from None

def admit_target_capacity(
    calibration: dict, *, source_commit: str, runner_environment: str,
    profile: str, available_memory_bytes: int, available_disk_bytes: int,
    job_timeout_seconds: int,
) -> dict:
    """Calculate a target gate from same-source, measured aggregate peaks.

    A trusted CI producer must supply this schema; hand-authored values are not
    an admission receipt. The final acceptance still needs 500 overlapping
    server task intervals on the isolated host.
    """
    if runner_environment != "self-hosted":
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity target requires a dedicated self-hosted runner")
    if not isinstance(calibration, dict):
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity calibration must be a JSON object")
    if (type(calibration.get("schema")) is not int or calibration["schema"] != 2
            or calibration.get("source_commit") != source_commit
            or calibration.get("pilot_passed") is not True):
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity target needs passing same-source measured calibration v2")
    if (calibration.get("worker_container_peak_metric") not in
            {"cgroup_v2_memory_peak", "cgroup_v1_max_usage"}
            or calibration.get("driver_peak_metric") != "process_rss_peak"
            or calibration.get("fixed_stack_peak_metric") != "sum_cgroup_memory_peak"
            or type(calibration.get("observed_worker_slots")) is not int
            or calibration["observed_worker_slots"] != TARGET_SLOTS_PER_WORKER
            or type(calibration.get("observed_worker_task_receipts")) is not int
            or calibration["observed_worker_task_receipts"] < 16
            or type(calibration.get("driver_sample_threads")) is not int
            or calibration["driver_sample_threads"] < 2):
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity calibration lacks four-slot cgroup and driver sampling provenance")
    fields = ("worker_container_peak_bytes", "driver_idle_peak_bytes",
              "driver_sample_peak_bytes", "fixed_stack_peak_bytes",
              "disk_bytes_per_operation", "measured_operations_per_second")
    if any(type(calibration.get(field)) not in (int, float)
           or not 0 < calibration[field] <= 2**63 - 1
           or not math.isfinite(calibration[field]) for field in fields):
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity calibration lacks finite measured resource values")
    if calibration["driver_sample_peak_bytes"] <= calibration["driver_idle_peak_bytes"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity driver sample must exceed its measured idle baseline")
    if any(type(value) is not int or value <= 0 for value in
           (available_memory_bytes, available_disk_bytes, job_timeout_seconds)):
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity target resource measurements must be positive integers")
    worker_limit = 1536 * MIB  # A ceiling for each replica, not a RAM reservation.
    replicas = TARGET_SLOTS // TARGET_SLOTS_PER_WORKER
    worker_peak = calibration["worker_container_peak_bytes"]
    headroom = 1.5
    if worker_peak * headroom > worker_limit:
        raise RuntimeError("Measured four-slot worker cannot fit its container ceiling with headroom")
    driver_increment_per_thread = ((calibration["driver_sample_peak_bytes"] -
                                    calibration["driver_idle_peak_bytes"]) /
                                   calibration["driver_sample_threads"])
    projected_driver_peak = calibration["driver_idle_peak_bytes"] + TARGET_SLOTS * driver_increment_per_thread
    memory_required = math.ceil(headroom * (
        replicas * worker_peak + projected_driver_peak + calibration["fixed_stack_peak_bytes"]
    ))
    disk_required = math.ceil(max(20 * GIB, 2 * TARGET_OPERATIONS * calibration["disk_bytes_per_operation"]))
    # Pilot rate is only a planning bound; actual target throughput is measured.
    time_required = max(7200, math.ceil(2 * TARGET_OPERATIONS /
        calibration["measured_operations_per_second"]))
    if profile not in {"accelerated", "burst", "sustained"}:
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported target rate profile")
    if available_memory_bytes < memory_required:
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity target has insufficient measured available memory")
    if available_disk_bytes < disk_required:
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity target has insufficient measured free disk")
    if job_timeout_seconds < time_required:
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity target job timeout is shorter than measured workload allowance")
    return {"worker_slots": TARGET_SLOTS, "worker_replicas": replicas,
            "memory_required_bytes": memory_required, "disk_required_bytes": disk_required,
            "job_timeout_required_seconds": time_required, "profile": profile,
            "source_commit": source_commit, "worker_container_peak_bytes": worker_peak,
            "worker_container_peak_metric": calibration["worker_container_peak_metric"]}


def _available_target_memory_bytes() -> int:
    try:
        available = next(
            int(line.split()[1]) * 1024 for line in Path("/proc/meminfo").read_text().splitlines()
            if line.startswith("MemAvailable:")
        )
    except (OSError, ValueError, StopIteration) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot measure available host memory for target admission") from exc
    cgroup = Path("/sys/fs/cgroup")
    v2_limit = cgroup / "memory.max"
    v1_limit = cgroup / "memory/memory.limit_in_bytes"
    try:
        if v2_limit.exists():
            limit_text = v2_limit.read_text().strip()
            if limit_text != "max":
                remaining = int(limit_text) - int((cgroup / "memory.current").read_text().strip())
                available = min(available, max(0, remaining))
        elif v1_limit.exists():
            limit = int(v1_limit.read_text().strip())
            if limit < 2**60:  # v1's enormous sentinel denotes no memory limit.
                remaining = limit - int((cgroup / "memory/memory.usage_in_bytes").read_text().strip())
                available = min(available, max(0, remaining))
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("Cannot identify memory cgroup for target admission")
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot measure memory cgroup for target admission") from exc
    return available


def require_target_admission(source_commit: str) -> dict:
    # A dedicated workflow stages the prior isolated calibration job's three
    # exact artifacts privately. The normal 60-minute runner cannot opt in.
    private = Path(SOURCE) / "test-results/ci-private"
    names = ("capacity-target-calibration.json", "capacity-target-pilot-report.json",
             "capacity-target-ci-environment.json")
    raw = {}
    try:
        for name in names:
            path = private / name
            if (path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file()
                    or path.stat().st_mode & 0o077 or path.stat().st_size > 1_000_000):
                raise RuntimeError("Full capacity target needs three private calibration artifacts")
            raw[name] = path.read_bytes()
        calibration, pilot, pilot_environment = (
            json.loads(raw[name]) for name in names
        )
        timeout = int(os.environ["CI_STORAGE_CAPACITY_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"])
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, UnicodeError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity target lacks measured calibration or declared dedicated timeout") from exc
    if any(not isinstance(value, dict) for value in (calibration, pilot, pilot_environment)):
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity target calibration artifacts must be JSON objects")
    run_id = os.environ.get("CI_STORAGE_CAPACITY_CALIBRATION_RUN_ID", "")
    harness = os.environ.get("CI_HARNESS_COMMIT", "")
    if (not run_id.isdecimal() or int(run_id) <= 0
            or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{40}", harness)
            or any(entry.get("source_commit") != source_commit for entry in
                   (calibration, pilot_environment))
            or any(entry.get("harness_commit") != harness for entry in
                   (calibration, pilot_environment))
            or any(str(entry.get("run_id")) != run_id for entry in
                   (calibration, pilot_environment))
            or calibration.get("pilot_report_sha256") !=
            hashlib.sha256(raw[names[1]]).hexdigest()
            or calibration.get("ci_environment_sha256") !=
            hashlib.sha256(raw[names[2]]).hexdigest()):
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity calibration source, harness, run or report digest differs")
    capacity = pilot_environment.get("storage_capacity") or {}
    counts = pilot.get("counts") or {}
    provider = pilot.get("provider") or {}
    hardware = pilot.get("hardware") or {}
    if (not all(isinstance(value, dict) for value in (capacity, counts, provider, hardware))
            or pilot.get("passed") is not True
            or pilot.get("validation_level") != "pilot"
            or counts != {"round": 240, "embed": 32, "version": 32}
            or type(pilot.get("server_task_peak_concurrency")) is not int
            or pilot["server_task_peak_concurrency"] < 4
            or type(pilot.get("task_receipt_count")) is not int
            or pilot["task_receipt_count"] < 16
            or capacity.get("provider_credentials") != "absent"
            or capacity.get("provider_network") != "internal"
            or capacity.get("observed_worker_processes") != 4
            or capacity.get("worker_replicas") != 1
            or any(provider.get(name) != 0 for name in (
                "real_provider_calls", "blocked_provider_calls", "cache_misses"))
            or type(provider.get("cache_hits")) is not int
            or provider["cache_hits"] <= 0
            or hardware.get("worker_threads") != 4
            or hardware.get("driver_idle_peak_bytes") != calibration.get("driver_idle_peak_bytes")
            or hardware.get("driver_sample_peak_bytes") != calibration.get("driver_sample_peak_bytes")
            or hardware.get("driver_peak_metric") != calibration.get("driver_peak_metric")
            or pilot.get("task_receipt_count") != calibration.get("observed_worker_task_receipts")):
        raise RuntimeError("Full capacity target lacks a verified zero-provider four-slot calibration pilot")
    try:
        docker_root = subprocess.check_output(
            ["docker", "info", "--format", "{{.DockerRootDir}}"], text=True, timeout=10,
        ).strip()
        if not docker_root or not Path(docker_root).is_dir():
            raise RuntimeError("Cannot measure Docker volume disk for target admission")
        available_disk = min(shutil.disk_usage(SOURCE).free, shutil.disk_usage(docker_root).free)
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot measure Docker volume disk for target admission") from exc
    return admit_target_capacity(
        calibration, source_commit=source_commit,
        runner_environment=os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT", ""),
        profile=os.environ.get("CI_STORAGE_CAPACITY_PROFILE", "accelerated"),
        available_memory_bytes=_available_target_memory_bytes(),
        available_disk_bytes=available_disk,
        job_timeout_seconds=timeout,
    )

def require_runner():
    dedicated_capacity = (
        os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") == "self-hosted"
        and os.environ.get("OPENMATES_CI_CAPACITY_DEDICATED") == "1"
        and json.loads(os.environ.get("CI_SPECS_JSON", "[]")) == ["storage-capacity-target.spec.ts"]
    )
    if (
        os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") != "true"
        or (os.environ.get("RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT") != "github-hosted" and not dedicated_capacity)
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("Isolated stacks require GitHub-hosted or dedicated capacity runners")


def compose(*args, capture=False, timeout=90):
    require_runner()
    return subprocess.run(
        ["docker", "compose", "-f", str(COMPOSE_PATH), *args],
        cwd=SOURCE,
        check=True,
        text=True,
        capture_output=capture,
        timeout=timeout,
    )


def start_stack(*, compose_runner=None, sleep=time.sleep):
    """Start once, retrying only bounded registry/network pull failures."""
    compose_runner = compose if compose_runner is None else compose_runner
    attempts = len(STACK_START_RETRY_DELAYS) + 1
    for attempt in range(attempts):
        try:
            result = compose_runner(
                "up",
                "-d",
                "--no-build",
                "--wait",
                "--wait-timeout",
                "600",
                capture=True,
                timeout=720,
            )
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
            stdout = exc.stdout or exc.output or ""
            stderr = exc.stderr or ""
            if stdout:
                sys.stdout.write(stdout)
            if stderr:
                sys.stderr.write(stderr)
            combined = stdout + "\n" + stderr
            if attempt >= len(STACK_START_RETRY_DELAYS) or not TRANSIENT_REGISTRY_FAILURE.search(combined):
                raise
            delay = STACK_START_RETRY_DELAYS[attempt]
            print(
                f"Transient container registry failure; retrying isolated stack start "
                f"in {delay}s ({attempt + 2}/{attempts}).",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            sleep(delay)
            continue
        if result.stdout:
            sys.stdout.write(result.stdout)
        if result.stderr:
            sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
        return result
    raise AssertionError("unreachable")


def apply_prepared_schema(profile: dict, runtime_evidence: dict) -> bool:
    """Select the compatible schema image without sharing a database or volume."""
    schema_image = next(
        (
            image
            for image in runtime_evidence.get("images", [])
            if image.get("kind") == "schema" and image.get("reused") is True
        ),
        None,
    )
    if not schema_image:
        return False
    if (
        schema_image.get("bundle_format") != SCHEMA_BUNDLE_FORMAT
        or schema_image.get("restore_semantics") != SCHEMA_RESTORE_SEMANTICS
    ):
        return False
    services = profile["services"]
    services["cms-database"]["image"] = "openmates-ci-database:local"
    services["cms-setup"]["environment"].update(
        CI_PREPARED_SCHEMA="1",
        CI_PREPARED_SCHEMA_ADMIN_PASSWORD=PREPARED_SCHEMA_ADMIN_PASSWORD,
    )
    return True


def select_runtime_profile() -> bool:
    evidence_path = Path(SOURCE) / "test-results/ci-runtime-images.json"
    if not evidence_path.is_file() or not COMPOSE_PATH.is_file():
        return False
    profile = json.loads(COMPOSE_PATH.read_text())
    evidence = json.loads(evidence_path.read_text())
    if not apply_prepared_schema(profile, evidence):
        return False
    COMPOSE_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(profile))
    COMPOSE_PATH.chmod(0o600)
    return True


def startup_service_timings(started_at: float) -> list[dict]:
    """Collect bounded state metadata, excluding environment and health output."""
    containers = compose("ps", "-aq", capture=True, timeout=20).stdout.split()
    if not containers:
        return []
    if len(containers) > 256 or any(not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{12,64}", item)
                                    for item in containers):
        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected isolated container inventory")
    template = ('{"service":{{json (index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service")}},'
                '"started":{{json .State.StartedAt}},"finished":{{json .State.FinishedAt}},'
                '"status":{{json .State.Status}},"exit_code":{{json .State.ExitCode}},'
                '"health":{{if .State.Health}}{{json .State.Health.Status}}{{else}}null{{end}}}')
    output = subprocess.check_output(["docker", "inspect", "--format", template,
                                      *containers], text=True, timeout=20)
    allowed = set(json.loads(COMPOSE_PATH.read_text())["services"])
    result = []
    for line in output.splitlines():
        state = json.loads(line)
        if state["service"] not in allowed:
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected service in isolated container inventory")
        item = {key: state[key] for key in ("service", "status", "exit_code", "health")}
        timestamps = {}
        for field in ("started", "finished"):
            value = datetime.fromisoformat(state[field].replace("Z", "+00:00")).timestamp()
            if value >= started_at:
                timestamps[field] = value
                item[field + "_after_stack_seconds"] = round(value - started_at, 3)
        if "started" in timestamps and "finished" in timestamps:
            item["execution_seconds"] = round(timestamps["finished"] - timestamps["started"], 3)
        result.append(item)
    return sorted(result, key=lambda item: item["service"])


def start_with_evidence():
    """Retain useful phase timings even when a disposable bootstrap fails."""
    begin = time.time()
    selected = select_runtime_profile()
    selected_at = time.time()
    report = {"format_version": 1, "schema_mode": "prepared" if selected else "cold",
              "profile_selection_seconds": round(selected_at - begin, 3),
              "run_id": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID"),
              "harness_commit": os.environ.get("CI_HARNESS_COMMIT"), "outcome": "failed"}
    try:
        result = start_stack()
        report["outcome"] = "ready"
        return result
    finally:
        report["compose_wait_seconds"] = round(time.time() - selected_at, 3)
        try:
            report["services"] = startup_service_timings(selected_at)
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
            # Timing collection must never replace the actual startup result.
            report["timing_collection_error"] = type(exc).__name__
        destination = Path(SOURCE) / "test-results/ci-startup-phases.json"
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        destination.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


def validate_ai_worker_queues(command: list[str], environment_queues: str, *, voice_camera: bool) -> list[str]:
    """Compare actual worker inputs, retaining only validated queue names."""
    def parse(value: str) -> set[str]:
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or len(value) > 1024:
            raise RuntimeError("Isolated AI worker queues are invalid")
        values = value.split(",")
        if any(not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}", name) for name in values):
            raise RuntimeError("Isolated AI worker queues are invalid")
        return set(values)

    if not isinstance(command, list) or not all(isinstance(part, str) for part in command):
        raise RuntimeError("Isolated AI worker command is invalid")
    declared = []
    for index, part in enumerate(command):
        if part.startswith("--queues="):
            declared.append(part.partition("=")[2])
        elif part in {"--queues", "-Q"}:
            declared.append(command[index + 1] if index + 1 < len(command) else "")
    if len(declared) != 1:

def inspect_ai_worker_queues(container: str, *, voice_camera: bool) -> list[str]:
    """Read only the command and named queue variable, never emit environment."""
    template = ('{{json .Config.Cmd}}\n{{range .Config.Env}}'
                '{{if eq (index (split . "=") 0) "CELERY_QUEUES"}}{{println .}}{{end}}{{end}}')
    raw = subprocess.check_output(
        ["docker", "inspect", "--format", template, container], text=True, timeout=10,
    )
    output = [line for line in raw.splitlines() if line]
    if len(output) != 2 or not output[1].startswith("CELERY_QUEUES="):
        raise RuntimeError("Isolated AI worker requires one CELERY_QUEUES value")
    try:
        command = json.loads(output[0])
    except ValueError:
        raise RuntimeError("Isolated AI worker command is invalid") from None
    return validate_ai_worker_queues(command, output[1].partition("=")[2], voice_camera=voice_camera)


def inspect_speech_worker_queues(container: str) -> list[str]:
    """Prove speech has an independent consumer without the busy AI queue."""
    queues = inspect_ai_worker_queues(container, voice_camera=False)
    if queues != ["app_music"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Voice fixture requires an independent shared-speech queue consumer")
    return queues
